source.description: One reviewed six-panel felt-tip marker contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one face-free submarine, one capsule hull, one tower, one bent periscope, exactly three portholes, two tail fins, one three-blade propeller, one lower side fin, exactly six rivets, three bubbles, and one broken water shadow stable.

process_strategy: Map every mechanical footprint and count in pale construction, preserve the tower and bent periscope through every later panel while building the full silhouette, ink only elements already visible, introduce the limited vintage-marine palette before the final panel, and finish with line-weight and highlight cleanup only.

final_elements.description: Pale construction fixes one long capsule hull, small tower, bent periscope route, two tail fins, a three-blade propeller, lower side fin, three porthole centers, three bubble routes, and a broken shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: complete submarine silhouette
final_elements.description: One readable submarine with a rounded nose, capsule hull, tower, two tail fins, three-blade propeller, and lower side fin.

final_elements.name: bent periscope three portholes six rivets and three bubbles
final_elements.description: One bent periscope, exactly three round portholes, one hull seam, exactly six rivets, and exactly three bubbles in three sizes.

final_elements.name: thick black felt-tip outline and broken water shadow
final_elements.description: Handmade black marker reinforces every established contour while one broken oval water shadow grounds the submarine.

final_elements.name: mustard navy rust and seafoam marker fills
final_elements.description: A limited vintage-marine palette fills the established hull, windows, fins, bubbles, and shadow with visible marker streaks and highlight gaps.

rejection_checks: Keep the same face-free submarine, upward tilt, crop, scale, hull proportions, tower, fins, propeller, and bubble placement in all six panels.
The bent periscope route introduced in Step 1 must remain visible in Step 2 and every later panel; it may never disappear and return.
Exactly three portholes, six rivets, three bubbles, two tail fins, one three-blade propeller, and one lower side fin must appear before bold ink or color and persist.
Do not introduce a porthole, rivet, bubble, seam, fin, propeller blade, periscope bend, shadow shape, or color area in the final panel.
Do not add eyes, mouth, passenger, fish, seabed, coral, text, label, arrow, number, signature, watermark, sticker border, or badge frame.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and imperfect handmade edges rather than vector-clean icon art or polished poster rendering.
